title: Analyst
description:
**About Analog Devices**
 Analog Devices, Inc. (NASDAQ: ADI) is a global semiconductor leader that bridges the physical and digital worlds to enable breakthroughs at the Intelligent Edge. ADI combines analog, digital, AI, and software technologies into solutions that combat climate change, reliably connect humans and the world, and help drive advancements in automation and robotics, mobility, healthcare, energy and data centers. With revenue of more than $11 billion in FY25, ADI ensures today's innovators stay Ahead of What's Possible. Learn more at www.analog.com and on LinkedIn and X.
   

  

**Job Description:**
**Responsibilities:**
* Work with multiple internal teams to understand and resolve Production issues
* Adapt to new technologies in quick time
* May need to work in shifts to support workflows in multiple env
* Complete the assigned tasks in timely manner with min or zero defects
* Ability to manage multiple priorities


**Minimum Qualifications:**
* 1\-2 years of experience in RDBMS, Oracle SQL, PL/SQL
* Exposure to Shell/Batch scripting
* Knowledge on Python will be a plus
* Experience in Implementation/Production Support for any ERP/SCM solutions will be a plus
* Experience with Oracle 10g and 11g will be a plus
* Strong communication skills, with demonstrated ability to work effectively with technical and functional teams


 B.E. in Computer Science, Industrial Engineering, or equivalent technical degrees

title: Application Expert- Drives & Automation
description:
**Job Title** 
 : Assistant Manager/Manager
 



  





**Location** 
 : Sanand, Gujarat
 



  





**Company** 
 : Hitachi Hi\-Rel Power Electronics Private Limited
 



  





**Position Overview** 
 : As the Senior Application Expert (LV Drives), the candidate will be the technical backbone of our new LV business vertical. Reporting directly to the Channel Sales Head, this role's primary mandate is to create technical "pull" in the market by converting complex engineering specifications at the consultant, OEM, and end\-user levels. The candidate will bridge the gap between sales and technology—equipping our internal regional sales team and our channel partners (System Integrators and Distributors) with the application expertise needed to win high\-value, application\-specific business. The candidate will be coordinating with HIES/HINC for application code / software development if required to support local team to apply carry forward same OEMs in India.
 



  





**Department:** 
 Sales \& Marketing
 



  





**Position Reporting to:** 
 Channel Sales Head\- Sales \& Marketing
 



  





**Key Responsibilities:** 




  





 Responsible for meeting the LV1 Module Technical Support:
 



 1\.Act as the subject matter expert (SME) for complex, heavy\-duty, and specialized LV VFD applications across industries (e.g., crane/hoist, tension control, multi\-drive systems, Compressors, Extruders, high\-speed pumps/fans, and HVAC systems, Machinery, Level 1 Automation).
 



 2\.Conduct joint technical visits with channel partners to key OEMs, Industrial End\-Users, and Automation Consultants to influence technical specifications in favour of our Japanese technology.
 



 3\.Analyze customer technical requirements, perform sizing, selection, and configuration of drives, and prepare robust, foolproof technical proposals. Troubleshoot complex application challenges during the pre\-sales phase to demonstrate product superiority and build customer confidence.
 



 4\.Design and deliver structured technical training programs, product certification courses, and application workshops for System Integrators (SIs), Value Added Resellers (VARs), and Distributors.
 



 5\.Create a self\-reliant channel ecosystem by empowering partner engineers to handle standard configurations and basic commissioning independently.
 



 6\.Provide continuous technical mentoring and application support to the internal team of 7–8 regional channel managers.
 



 7\.Perform deep technical benchmarking against key competitors (e.g., ABB, Siemens, Danfoss, Schneider, Fuji, Yaskawa Etc) to identify our product USPs and counter competitor arguments.
 



 8\.Develop localized application notes, success stories, and technical whitepapers to support the field sales team.
 



 Gather market intelligence on required product modifications, software features, or customized firmware, feeding this data back to the global Japanese R\&D and Product Management teams.
 



**Education Qualifications** 
 : B.E \- Electrical/ Instrumentation/ Electronics/EC/ Industrial Engg.
 



**Experience** 
 : Min. 10 years with min 6\-7 Yrs of strictly focus on LV Product Technical support across various industries
 



  





**Essential Knowledge \& skills:** 
 Experience of LV Drive Application knowledge in various fields, PLC programming, code writing, Good Presentation skills, Training ability
 



  





**Preferred Knowledge \& Skills:** 
 LV Drive market knowledge and product knowledge. Gujarati, Hindi and English language proficiency. Should be local resident, ready to travel across India.

title: Lead Support Engineer
description:
**Job Summary** 




  





 IT Support Lead Engineer acts as
 **Level 3 support staff in the IT SD Support escalation matrix** 
 . As a lead engineer, you should have a solid technical background with Microsoft products, ticketing systems, security products like AV, DLP, Firewall, patch management. A problem\-solving attitude with an ability to train new hire and existing staff, can document troubleshooting and training KB articles, coaches’ team on technical issues. Can co\-ordinate with different cross functional team members, vendors for escalated issue resolution.
 



  





**Responsibilities and Duties** 




 1\. Act as L3 escalation point for unresolved cases and come up with a technical way ahead for challenging and unsolved IT SD Support cases.
 



 2\. Acts as technical mentor on floor to offer quick technical assistance to L1 and L2 engineers.
 



 3\. Trains new hires with IT SD technical training program.
 



 4\. Train, coach, and mentor L1/L2 Technical Support Engineers on technical aspects.
 



 5\. Acts as problem manager to come out with resolution for IT SD escalations and IT projects.
 



 6\. Demonstrable ability to think around issues and look at the wider picture in order to provide
 



 solutions through a variety of problem\-solving techniques.
 



 7\. Acts as technical SME on floor for ticket resolution.
 



 8\. Document organization SOP for various solutions implementation and maintenance related management.
 



 9\. Create internal and end user’s KB Articles.
 



 10\. Conduct technical awareness and troubleshooting trainings for existing staff.
 



 11\. Create SOP on recurring issues to capture troubleshooting steps.
 



 12\. Vendor management for product related deployment, upgrade, and escalation management.
 



 13\. Knowledge and understanding of best practice frameworks (such as ITIL, ISO20k).
 



  





**Desired skills \& competencies** 




 1\. Graduate in any discipline.
 



 2\. Expert in Microsoft products like desktop and server O.S., AD/Domain controller, WSUS, Bit locker, Exchange Server, O365\.
 



 3\. Sound knowledge of Endpoint security, DLP Products, WDS, SCCM.
 



 4\. Sound knowledge of windows OS, MS Severs, endpoints hardware and related troubleshooting.
 



 5\. At least 10 years \+ years of total IT experience with minimum 5 years of experience with IT Helpdesk / service desk in resolving technical escalation at level 2 and above profile.
 



 6\. Microsoft/O365 Certification.
 



 7\. Networking, security certification is an added advantage.
 



 8\. Drive, self\-motivation, and ability to work under own initiative.
 



 9\. Excellent customer Service Skills, Excellent problem\-solving skills.
 



 10\. Proactive and creative, Attention to detail, Excellent research skills.
 



 11\. Excellent English communication skill (both Written \& Verbal).
 



 12\. Customer\-centric
 



 13\. Problem Solver
 



 14\. Critical thinker
 



 15\. Can work under pressure
 



 16\. Multi\-tasking.
